quests.instruction: Which word means the direction on a family tree that points toward the future, not the past?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: Picture a family tree — this word points down toward newer branches.
quests.explanation: Descendants means the direction on a family tree that points toward the future, not the past.
quests.funFact: Family trees can be drawn either direction — but descendants always point toward what comes next!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes the strong feeling of love and connection between family members?
quests.question: Family Bond
quests.hint: This phrase is about feelings, not looks or customs.
quests.explanation: Family Bond describes the strong feeling of love and connection between family members.
quests.funFact: A strong family bond can help people feel supported through both happy times and hard times!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means customs a family keeps repeating because they feel meaningful and fun?
quests.question: Family Traditions
quests.hint: This phrase describes why families choose to repeat these customs.
quests.explanation: Family Traditions means customs a family keeps repeating because they feel meaningful and fun.
quests.funFact: Starting a brand-new family tradition can be just as special as continuing an old one!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes strangers noticing that a child looks just like their parent?
quests.question: Family Resemblance
quests.hint: This phrase is about a stranger's observation of physical looks.
quests.explanation: Family Resemblance describes strangers noticing that a child looks just like their parent.
quests.funFact: Strangers often comment on family resemblance the very first time they meet a parent and child together!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means a special occasion when relatives who live far apart come together?
quests.question: Family Reunion
quests.hint: Distance is often part of what makes this occasion special.
quests.explanation: Family Reunion means a special occasion when relatives who live far apart come together.
quests.funFact: Some relatives travel across the country, or even the world, just to attend a family reunion!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means your parents and siblings, distinct from your grandparents and cousins?
quests.question: Immediate Family
quests.hint: This word draws a clear line between your closest relatives and your wider family.
quests.explanation: Immediate Family means your parents and siblings, distinct from your grandparents and cousins.
quests.funFact: Understanding the difference between immediate and extended family helps make family trees easier to read!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means the diagram many people use to trace their ancestors back through history?
quests.question: Family Tree
quests.hint: This diagram maps out relatives across many generations.
quests.explanation: Family Tree means the diagram many people use to trace their ancestors back through history.
quests.funFact: Tracing ancestors through a family tree is a popular hobby known as genealogy!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the relatives your own descendants will study someday, including you?
quests.question: Ancestors
quests.hint: One day, you yourself will become this to your future family.
quests.explanation: Ancestors describes the relatives your own descendants will study someday, including you.
quests.funFact: Everyone eventually becomes an ancestor to someone in their family's future!

quests.instruction: Which word means everyone counted as living at your home, from parents to pets?
quests.question: Household
quests.hint: This word can even count pets as part of the count!
quests.explanation: Household means everyone counted as living at your home, from parents to pets.
quests.funFact: Some household surveys even ask about pets living in the home!

quests.instruction: Which word describes an entire age-based layer of relatives, like everyone born in the same era?
quests.question: Generation
quests.hint: This word groups relatives by age level, not by household.
quests.explanation: Generation describes an entire age-based layer of relatives, like everyone born in the same era.
quests.funFact: Historians often give nicknames to different generations based on the era they grew up in!

quests.instruction: Which word means the opposite of ancestors — family members from future generations?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: If ancestors look backward, this word looks forward.
quests.explanation: Descendants means the opposite of ancestors — family members from future generations.
quests.funFact: A family tree shows ancestors above and descendants below the person in the middle!

quests.instruction: Which phrase could explain why family members support each other during hard times?
quests.question: Family Bond
quests.hint: This phrase explains an emotional connection, not a physical trait.
quests.explanation: Family Bond could explain why family members support each other during hard times.
quests.funFact: Many people say their family bond is what helps them feel strong during difficult moments!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes special customs a family repeats together every year?
quests.question: Family Traditions
quests.hint: This phrase describes repeated customs, not a one-time event.
quests.explanation: Family Traditions describes special customs a family repeats together every year.
quests.funFact: Some family traditions have been passed down for so many generations that no one remembers how they started!

quests.instruction: Which phrase could describe why a father and son are often mistaken for each other in photos?
quests.question: Family Resemblance
quests.hint: This phrase explains a physical similarity, not an emotional connection.
quests.explanation: Family Resemblance could describe why a father and son are often mistaken for each other in photos.
quests.funFact: Looking at old photos of a parent as a child is a fun way to spot family resemblance!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes a big gathering where many relatives come together to celebrate?
quests.question: Family Reunion
quests.hint: This phrase describes an event, not just a group of people.
quests.explanation: Family Reunion describes a big gathering where many relatives come together to celebrate.
quests.funFact: Some family reunions happen every single year at the very same favorite location!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes the group that would fit most comfortably in a single family car?
quests.question: Immediate Family
quests.hint: This is usually your smallest, closest circle of relatives.
quests.explanation: Immediate Family describes the group that would fit most comfortably in a single family car.
quests.funFact: Many families choose a car size based on exactly how many people are in their immediate family!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes the kind of chart that would show where your descendants branch out below you?
quests.question: Family Tree
quests.hint: This chart shows both directions: ancestors above and descendants below.
quests.explanation: Family Tree describes the kind of chart that would show where your descendants branch out below you.
quests.funFact: A family tree can keep growing forever, as new descendants are added generation after generation!

quests.instruction: Which word means the earlier family members who lived before today's generations?
quests.question: Ancestors
quests.hint: This word points backward through your family's history.
quests.explanation: Ancestors means the earlier family members who lived before today's generations.
quests.funFact: Learning about ancestors can teach you fascinating details about history itself!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the group sharing one address, whether or not they are all related by blood?
quests.question: Household
quests.hint: This word is about the shared address, not just blood relation.
quests.explanation: Household describes the group sharing one address, whether or not they are all related by blood.
quests.funFact: A household can sometimes include close family friends who live together, not just blood relatives!

quests.instruction: Which word means the step on a family tree between ancestors and descendants?
quests.question: Generation
quests.hint: This word names one layer, positioned between the past and the future.
quests.explanation: Generation means the step on a family tree between ancestors and descendants.
quests.funFact: Every single person is part of a generation that sits between their own ancestors and descendants!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the children, grandchildren, and future family members who come after you?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: This word points toward the future, not the past.
quests.explanation: Descendants describes the children, grandchildren, and future family members who come after you.
quests.funFact: The word 'descend' means to come down from, just like descendants come down through a family line!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means the deep connection that keeps a family close, even during disagreements?
quests.question: Family Bond
quests.hint: This phrase describes closeness that survives even hard moments.
quests.explanation: Family Bond means the deep connection that keeps a family close, even during disagreements.
quests.funFact: Even families who sometimes disagree can still share a deep and lasting family bond!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes a game or song that has been part of a family's celebrations for years?
quests.question: Family Traditions
quests.hint: This phrase names a repeated custom, not a single celebration.
quests.explanation: Family Traditions describes a game or song that has been part of a family's celebrations for years.
quests.funFact: A favorite family song or game can bring back happy memories every time it is repeated!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means physical features shared between relatives, like eye color or height?
quests.question: Family Resemblance
quests.hint: This phrase is specifically about how relatives look, not how they feel about each other.
quests.explanation: Family Resemblance means physical features shared between relatives, like eye color or height.
quests.funFact: Even relatives who have never met can sometimes share a striking family resemblance!

quests.instruction: Which phrase could describe an annual event some families hold just to stay connected?
quests.question: Family Reunion
quests.hint: This phrase describes a repeated yearly gathering.
quests.explanation: Family Reunion could describe an annual event some families hold just to stay connected.
quests.funFact: Staying connected through yearly reunions helps keep even distant relatives feeling close!

quests.instruction: Which word means everyone who will eventually be born into your family line, going forward?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: This word stretches into the future of your family tree.
quests.explanation: Descendants means everyone who will eventually be born into your family line, going forward.
quests.funFact: Some very old families can trace descendants across hundreds of years and many generations!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means the emotional closeness that ties a family together?
quests.question: Family Bond
quests.hint: This phrase describes an emotional connection, not a single event.
quests.explanation: Family Bond means the emotional closeness that ties a family together.
quests.funFact: Family bonds can grow even stronger through shared experiences over time!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes customs that get passed down from one generation to the next?
quests.question: Family Traditions
quests.hint: This phrase is about the passing down of habits, not physical looks.
quests.explanation: Family Traditions describes customs that get passed down from one generation to the next.
quests.funFact: Learning a family tradition from a grandparent is a wonderful way to feel connected to family history!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means the visible similarities that run through generations of one family?
quests.question: Family Resemblance
quests.hint: This phrase is about what you can see, not what you feel.
quests.explanation: Family Resemblance means the visible similarities that run through generations of one family.
quests.funFact: Looking through generations of family photos is a fun way to trace family resemblance over time!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes the kind of event where you might meet a second cousin for the first time?
quests.question: Family Reunion
quests.hint: This phrase names the special occasion, not the relative you are meeting.
quests.explanation: Family Reunion describes the kind of event where you might meet a second cousin for the first time.
quests.funFact: Meeting a relative for the very first time is a common and exciting part of family reunions!
